tools.name: lookup_florida_license
tools.description: Look up a Florida DBPR food service / mobile food license (restaurants, food trucks, caterers) by license number, or by business name plus 5-digit zip. Returns status and expiry date from Florida DBPR public records (checked daily; DBPR updates about once a week, so it may lag). Read-only.

tools.name: get_state_food_rules
tools.description: Get verified food license rules (issuing agency, renewal cycle, expiry, fee, late fee, official link) for a US state and business type. Only rows verified against the full official page are returned; anything else returns 'Check with your local health department' and an official link. Never guesses.

tools.name: next_renewal_date
tools.description: Get the next food license renewal deadline. Give a Florida DBPR license_number for its real expiry date, or a state (plus optional city and business_type) for states/cities with a verified fixed yearly deadline (e.g. Michigan Apr 30).
